messages:
Ella Kim: hey all! i'm ella (she/her) — excited to start today as an inference eng. i collect sticky notes, love escape rooms, and make an excellent cup of tea. would love recs for local puzzle rooms or lunch buddies. :)
Maya Sato: welcome ella!! :tada: we have a few escape-room folks. btw tea club meets wednesdays at 3pm in kitchen A.
Raju: welcome!! sticky-note art is a hill i will gladly climb. where are you based?
Ella Kim: SF office — usually on-site tues/thurs. happy to bring sticky-note supplies.
Noah: hi ella — welcome to the madness. rooftop has two pothos looking for names if you want plant adoption duties :seedling:
Priya: hi! quick FYI onboarding doc: https://redwood.example/onboard/ella (DM me if link is flaky). i can grab lunch today if you want a tour of the pantry traps.
Juno: hey — there's an escape-room booking this sat at 6pm (team rate). DM me if you want in. we always need someone good at the locks :mag_right:
WelcomeBot: Ella Kim was added to #new-hires and granted access to office tea stash. Onboarding checklist updated: laptop provisioned, badge queued, 1:1 with manager scheduled.
Ella Kim: awesome, thanks everyone! i'll DM for the escape room and bring extra sticky notes/markers. also, if anyone wants to start a tiny weekend puzzle group, i'm in. :smile:
